story.title: Up, Up, Up!

panels.desc: Sunrise over the second garden: a big smiling yellow sun rises above the wall and the sky turns orange and gold. On the garden path a grey seal balancing a glowing golden seed on its nose races a green turtle with a patterned shell; Bun waves a leaf like a flag at the finish line, Hedgie cheers, Pip flutters above the racers. Hidden in the picture: the sun, the seal, the turtle. On his small hill in the background, Grumble puffs his cheeks and blows out his candle lantern — a little curl of smoke rises from it and the lantern is dark.
panels.ko: 해가 떠요. 물개가 코에 씨앗을 얹고 거북이와 달리기해요. 언덕 위 그럼블이 등불을 훅 불어 꺼요.

ask.en: What does Grumble do with the lantern?

panels.desc: A little campfire by the path with a red cooking pot of tomato soup bubbling on it; a plump red tomato sits on a plate and a glowing golden seed shines inside the tomato. Hedgie stirs the soup with a spoon and sniffs happily. Pip is trying to do the sound action by tapping a tooth — but a bird has no teeth, so it taps its beak with a wing and looks puzzled. Bun grins and taps her own front tooth. Behind them the new S letter tree with sun-, seal- and soup-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the tomato, the bowl of soup, a big white tooth-shaped cookie on the plate. In the dim corner of the garden, Grumble stumbles over a tree stump in the dark holding his unlit lantern, nightcap over his eyes.
panels.ko: 토마토 속에 씨앗이 있어요. 핍은 이를 톡톡 치려는데 이가 없어요! 어두워진 그럼블은 그루터기에 걸려 넘어져요.

panels.desc: A gust of wind blows through the garden. An open red umbrella with a glowing golden seed on its top is flying up into the sky, and Pip hangs on to the umbrella handle with both feet, going up, up, up with wide excited eyes. Bun jumps with her arms stretched up; Hedgie runs after it with his flower bouncing. Hidden in the picture: the umbrella, Pip going up with a big upward arrow of wind leaves beside it. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 바람이 불어 우산이 날아가요. 핍이 우산 손잡이를 잡고 위로, 위로!

panels.desc: The umbrella has landed softly by the round garden door in the wall. A friendly grown-up rabbit with a mustache, a green cap and a watering can — Uncle, Bun's uncle and the garden's gardener — holds the little door open and winks as if he has always known the secret. Bun and Hedgie look up at him with open mouths; Pip sits on the umbrella, glowing. Three new letter trees (S with sun, seal and soup fruits; T with turtle, tomato and tooth fruits; U with umbrella, up-balloon and uncle fruits) stand by the door. Grumble has run up beside the trees and stares at his lantern: it has lit itself again all on its own and now shines brighter than ever, and he holds it away from his face in surprise. Hidden in the picture: the uncle with the watering can, the red umbrella.
panels.ko: 우산이 문 앞에 내려앉았어요. 토끼 삼촌이 문을 열어 주며 윙크해요. 그럼블의 등불이 저절로 더 밝게 켜졌어요.

ask.en: Is the lantern on or off?

story.synopsis_ko: 해가 떴어요. 물개와 거북이가 달리기를 해요. 핍은 이가 없어서 부리를 톡톡. 우산이 핍을 매달고 날아가요! 그럼블이 등불을 껐는데 저절로 더 밝게 켜졌어요. 토끼 삼촌이 문을 열어 줘요.
story.so_far_ko: 여왕의 이불 밑에서 그럼블을 찾고 P·Q·R 나무를 키웠어요.
story.goal_ko: 해돋이 정원에서 씨앗 세 개를 찾아 S·T·U 나무를 키워요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the big sun rises slowly and its rays spread, the seal wobbles forward balancing the twinkling seed on its nose, the turtle plods beside it, the rabbit waves her leaf flag; far on the hill the raccoon blows out his lantern and a curl of smoke rises. Camera still. Bright, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: leaves swirl in the wind, the red umbrella lifts off the ground and floats up with the baby bird hanging from the handle, the golden seed on top sparkles, the rabbit and the hedgehog reach up and chase after it. Camera still. Light, airy, child-friendly. No text.
